title: Example 062 (D1, Raft election, several configurations) recorded with an obligation per configuration
description: build.py now records each run as an attempt at a frozen claim (step 3b of llm-dlc/loops/build-orchestration.md): result.json gains claim (what is checked, its scope, and SHA-256 fingerprints of the patch and the copied sources before and after it, and for D1 the model files), attempt (engine, flags, tool identities, the bytecode built, the pipeline job's VERIFY_JOB_ID/VERIFY_SOURCE_COMMIT/VERIFY_WORKDIR, how the run ended, and for jvmcontract proofs whether exploration was shown complete), conclusion (established/refuted/unresolved per obligation) and bundle (each evidence file with its SHA-256). The runner writes into its own attempt directory, and nothing is published into the example's folder until the result validates against the schema and the files match the bundle; evidence of an earlier run that the bundle does not list is removed. The verdict and every flat field must be unchanged; the new blocks must be present, attempt.pipeline must name this job, and the example's folder must hold exactly the files its bundle lists. 062 runs the Raft election model under several configurations: claim.inputs.model must fingerprint the specification and each configuration, and conclusion.obligations must list each configuration and the generated operator's contract.
expected: example 062 gives its expected verdict, violation: build.py prints 'as expected' and exits 0

resources.notes: TLC under each configuration of the Raft election model, minutes in all
